ui.fishing.aim: Pick a spot on the water
ui.fishing.waiting_hint: wait for the bite: a strike too soon scares the fish
ui.fishing.landing: Keep the line in the green
ui.fishing.landing_hint: hold to lift the rod, let go to lower it
ui.fishing.tight: Too tight: the line will break
ui.fishing.slack: Too slack: the fish will slip off
ui.fishing.lost_early: Too soon: the fish got scared
ui.fishing.lost_late: Too late: the fish took the bait
ui.fishing.lost_slack: The fish slipped off the hook
